column1: # WikiText-2: one-step map trained on a denoiser's own samples. Teacher = time-free denoiser with random clean positions on every
# sample (6000 steps from data), sampled with continuous adaptive speed 1 + 2g, 32 steps. Student = whole jump of a flow map, started
# from the teacher's weights, 3000 steps on (noise, teacher sample) pairs; no data and no outside teacher in this stage. 4 seeds.
